checks.name: required_audit_coverage
checks.detail: report covers all 24 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is `decision_meta` valid, APPROVED, and on `project_governance`?
Is `reverse-agent-iteration@v2` active in `.codex-skills/registry.json`?
Does command-plan carry this decision ID and round ID?
Does command-plan select standard/full profile rather than fast profile?
Does command-plan include pytest instead of listing pytest in omitted_commands?
Does command-plan include run-closeout and close-round because this decision requires closeout?
Did startup status commands run in the required order before substantive work?
Did preflight pass before implementation?
Were all executed non-startup commands authorized by command-plan?
Were any omitted commands executed?
Did source/test changes stay within allowed files?
Were forbidden state files left unchanged?
Did pytest run and pass?
Does `pytest_result.txt` carry the current decision ID, report ID, round ID, and command transcript?
Do recorded command exit codes match command-plan expected exit codes, including run-closeout and close-round?
Does report-summary pass and match the execution report?
Does final-check pass?
Does run-closeout pass?
Does close-round pass and generate `project_state/rounds/round_20260708_profile_contract_closeout_consistency_rework_v1/round_manifest.json`?
Do generated_artifacts / files_changed cover current round delta and round archive artifacts without stale omissions?
Are nested FAILED states absent from `run_closeout_result.json` when the report claims acceptance?
Does `execution_report.md` semantically match `codex_execution_report.md`?
Did the round avoid Phase A.1, domains, sample solving, Web, database, runner, workflow, cleanup, deletion, file moves, and external tool work?
Did the final report refrain from claiming acceptance until all required gates passed?
